title: 第5章 不打自招了
slug: 帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾全本免费-帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾最新章节列表
content_zh:
但却有唯一一个例外！
那就是C国神祇一样的人物，慕非池。
传说他十五岁就跟着慕司令横扫边境反毒集团，十六岁组建了自己的野战特战部队“飞狼”！
这支被誉为C国最神秘的特种部队，外界只听说过名字，各国情报机关也搞不到对于这支部队的具体材料！
恰恰是因为有这支特战队镇场，各国反派势力才不敢随意挑衅C国。
她记得，历史课上有记载，在他十八岁的时候，他带领的飞狼特战队歼灭了敌方一个师的力量，生生把人逼回了国境线。
慕司令已经是军中一把手，慕非池更是青出于蓝而胜于蓝！
年纪轻轻，他为C国做出的功勋足以和他父亲并肩。
为了区分，总统在军衔史上特地封了他一个“少帅”的称号。
C国仅此唯一，最年轻司令级别的统帅。
云曦怎么都没想到，自己重生回来就闯进了这个男人的地盘！
抬眼看去，漆黑的水眸刹那间撞进了那双幽邃的鹰眸中，身居高位的军人气场让人肃然起敬。
心跳骤然加速。
她蹲下身捡起半块杯子底碎片，沾了上头凹槽里的水舔了舔，淡淡的涩味弥漫在舌尖。
上辈子她半生时间都耗在实验室里，这种看似无色无味的东西她一尝就知道是什么。
乙醚和东莨菪碱的成分不高，这个年代提纯不容易，想必韩婉灵搞到这东西也花了不少力气。
“水里边确实被人下药了！”
她转头看向慕非池，视线最终落在韩婉灵心虚的脸上。
慕非池凌厉的视线却落在云曦身上，隐约带着几分审视。
小丫头片子竟然能尝出来水里下了药？

一听到下药俩字，韩婉灵顿时急了。
“不……少帅，不是我做的！我根本就没碰你那杯水！”
她知道他的洁癖，不会碰不信任的人碰过的东西，所以她只是把药水滴在了杯壁上！
云曦半眯着眼，笑得无辜：“这屋子好像就我们仨吧？”
韩婉灵猛地转头瞪向云曦，急切的替自己打掩护。
“你别胡说八道！你一个黄毛丫头懂什么，别想栽赃到我头上！”
“我栽赃谁了吗？”
云曦挑挑眉，眨着眼一脸无辜的坐进沙发里，盘着腿看韩婉灵继续作死。
这么蹩脚的演技，实在是此地无银三百两啊！
她这是当慕非池傻子了么？
她记得，上辈子韩婉灵的演技挺不错的啊！
她跟她那个小三上位的妈联手陷害她的时候，套路剧本可是一套一套的，都够演一出苦情剧了！
怎么这辈子提前遇到她，反而智商不在服务区了？
“我……这里只有我们几个，不是你栽赃我，难不成你还栽赃少帅自己给自己下迷药吗？”
云曦轻笑了声，眯起了月儿弯弯的双眸，支着下巴靠在沙发上，饶有趣味的提醒她。
“我刚刚可没说是迷药哦，这么快就不打自招了？”
“你……”韩婉灵猛地意识到自己说漏了嘴，要收口也已经来不及了。

content_en:
But there is one exception!
That is the god-like figure of Country C, Mu Feichi.
Legend has it that at the age of fifteen, he followed Commander Mu to sweep across border anti-drug groups, and at the age of sixteen he formed his own field special operations force "Flying Wolf"!
This is known as the most mysterious special force of country C. The outside world has only heard of its name, and the intelligence agencies of various countries cannot obtain specific information about this force!
It is precisely because of this special force that the villains from various countries do not dare to provoke Country C at will.
She remembered that it was recorded in the history class that when he was eighteen years old, the Airwolf Special Forces he led annihilated an enemy division and forced people back to the border.
Commander Mu is already the top leader in the army, and Mu Feichi is even better than his master!
At such a young age, his contribution to country C is comparable to that of his father.
In order to distinguish him, the president specially gave him the title of "Young Marshal" in the history of military ranks.
Country C is the only and youngest commander-in-chief.
Yun Xi never expected that she would break into this man's territory after being reborn!
Looking up, the dark watery eyes suddenly crashed into the deep eagle eyes. The aura of a soldier in a high position made people awe-inspiring.
The heartbeat suddenly accelerated.
She knelt down and picked up half a piece of the bottom of the cup. She dipped it into the water in the groove and licked it. A faint astringent taste filled the tip of her tongue.
She spent half of her life in the laboratory, and she knew what this seemingly colorless and tasteless thing was as soon as she tasted it.
The ingredients of ether and scopolamine are not high, and it is not easy to purify them in this era. Han Wanling must have spent a lot of effort to get these things.
"The water was indeed drugged!"
She turned to look at Mu Feichi, and her eyes finally fell on Han Wanling's guilty face.
Mu Feichi's sharp eyes fell on Yun Xi, with a hint of scrutiny.
The little girl can taste the drug in the water?
As soon as he heard the word "drug", Han Wanling became anxious.
"No... Young Marshal, I didn't do it! I didn't touch your glass of water at all!"
She knew about his mysophobia and would not touch things that had been touched by people she didn't trust, so she just dropped the potion on the wall of the cup!
Yun Xi half-squinted her eyes and smiled innocently: "It seems like there are just the three of us in this room, right?"
Han Wanling suddenly turned her head and glared at Yun Xi, eager to cover for herself.
"Don't talk nonsense! What do you, a yellow-haired girl, know? Don't try to frame me!"
"Did I frame someone?"
Yun Xi raised her eyebrows, blinked and sat on the sofa with an innocent look on her face, crossing her legs to watch Han Wanling continue to seek death.
Such poor acting skills, there is really no silver 300 taels here!
Is she thinking Mu Feichi is a fool?
She remembered that Han Wanling's acting skills were quite good in her previous life!
When she and her mother, who was the mistress, teamed up to frame her, they had a lot of routines and scripts, which were enough to act out a bitter drama!
How come I met her early in this life, but her IQ was no longer in the service area?
"I...there are only a few of us here. You didn't frame me. Could it be that you framed the young marshal for drugging yourself?"
Yun Xi chuckled softly, narrowed Yue'er's crescent eyes, leaned on the sofa with her chin propped up, and reminded her interestingly.
"I didn't say I was drugged just now. Why don't you just blame yourself so soon?"
"You..." Han Wanling suddenly realized that she had spilled the beans and it was too late to stop.
